name: Camouflage
description: Digital camouflage: four drab inks laid in blotches by a smooth field, each cell split into pixels that dither where one blotch gives way to the next.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --n: @rn(-0.5, 1.5, 2.2); --j1: @r(-0.12, 0.12); --j2: @r(-0.12, 0.12); --j3: @r(-0.12, 0.12); background: @match($(n + j1) < 0.3, @p(var(--color1)), $(n + j1) < 0.5, @p(var(--color2)), $(n + j1) < 0.7, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: 50%; height: 50%; background: @match($(n + j2) < 0.3, @p(var(--color1)), $(n + j2) < 0.5, @p(var(--color2)), $(n + j2) < 0.7, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 50%; height: 50%; background: @match($(n + j3) < 0.3, @p(var(--color1)), $(n + j3) < 0.5, @p(var(--color2)), $(n + j3) < 0.7, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
